sources.title: [bug]: Flux.2 Klein 9B text encoder compatibility limitations · Issue #8839 · invoke-ai/InvokeAI
sources.snippet: I expected the different varieties, especially the quantized ones, of the Qwen3-8B encoder to work to conserve memory. But that did not happen, only a specific version works and that too only with the Flux.2 Klein-9B_Q4_K_M.gguf version of the model. I have not been able get the fp8 version of the Klein 9B model to work at all so far.
